meta.name: lark-workflow-standup-report
meta.description: 日程待办摘要：编排 calendar +agenda 和 task +get-my-tasks，生成指定日期的日程与未完成任务摘要。适用于了解今天/明天/本周的安排。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动汇总日程与待办，生成每日工作摘要
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每天需要快速了解当日日程和未完成任务
copy.tagline_en: Automatically summarize calendar and tasks for daily standup
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick daily summary of your schedule and pending tasks

howto.what: 当你询问日程或待办时，Claude 会读取你的飞书日历和任务列表，生成指定日期的会议、待办事项摘要，包含时间、状态和空闲时段提醒。
howto.when: 当你提到“今天有什么安排”“明天的日程”“本周待办”这类关键词时触发。

say.note: Claude 会获取今天的日历和待办并生成摘要。

say.text: 帮我看看明天的日程和待办
say.note: Claude 会计算明天的日期并生成对应摘要。

say.text: 这周还有哪些未完成的任务
say.note: Claude 会获取本周内未完成的待办并汇总。

howto.what_en: When you ask about your schedule or tasks, Claude will fetch your Lark calendar and task list, then generate a summary of meetings and to-dos for a specific date, including time, status, and free time slots.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention phrases like "what's on my schedule today", "tomorrow's agenda", or "this week's to-dos".

say_en.note: Claude gets today's calendar and tasks and makes a summary.

say_en.text: Show me tomorrow's schedule and tasks.
say_en.note: Claude computes tomorrow's date and generates the summary.

say_en.text: What are my unfinished tasks this week?
say_en.note: Claude fetches this week's pending tasks and lists them.
